submissionAttempts.body:
Host-contract version that applies: generation 1 (HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1), exact-match.

Decision basis (local, ordered by authority):
1. Pinned dependency ships the constant. `node_modules/@ordarium/core` is 1.3.1 (the release the workspace pins) and its host boundary declares `export const HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1` with `assertHostContract(v)` doing an exact `v !== HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION` check that throws `HostContractMismatchError` (no tolerance layer). `@ordarium/host-kit` 1.3.1 is a curated re-export of exactly that constant/handshake from core, so it introduces no host-specific contract generation.
2. Pin chain agrees. `package.json` depends on the ordarium-v1.3.1 tarballs for `@ordarium/core`, `@ordarium/host-kit`, `@ordarium/ledger-sqlite`; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides the four `@ordarium/*` packages to the same ordarium-v1.3.1 tarballs; installed `core`/`host-kit` package.json both report 1.3.1. Pin, override and installed artifact are consistent.
3. Workspace assembly matches. `src/effects/runtime.ts:128` pins `assertHostContract(1)` at assembly, and `test/host_conformance.test.ts` CONF-A01 asserts `assertHostContract(1)` passes while `assertHostContract(2)` throws. So the integration's declared target equals the shipped generation.
4. Governance docs agree. `docs/engineering/13-host-adapter-conformance-spec.md` (§0, §1.1, §2, CONF-A01) records G18/PLMP-CONF-1 as "contract generation 1" with fail-closed exact-match and no shim; `docs/engineering/07-ordarium-alignment.md` r10/r19 record that there is no `HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION`→2 plan.
5. The superseded interface note carries no authority. `docs/engineering/11-superseded-interface-note.md` is explicitly marked SUPERSEDED — "Replaced by the pinned dependency's shipped contract" — so it is void for the current pinned integration; the applicable value is read off the pinned artifact as above.

Conflicts examined and resolved locally rather than escalated: (a) docs/07 r8/r11 and `docker/minimal/README.md` still name the ordarium-v1.2.0 release while package.json/overrides name v1.3.1 — this is stale documentation of the *release* pin, not a different *contract generation*; both releases carry generation 1 (v1.3.1 verified directly from the shipped constant, v1.2.0 is the release under which PLMP-CONF-1 pinned `assertHostContract(1)`). (b) The superseded note has no version content and is explicitly void. No load-bearing source remains unresolved, so no peer contact was warranted.

Result: the applicable host-contract version is generation 1; the workspace is conformant (literal 1 == HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION 1) and would fail closed on any generation-2 dependency bump.
